verdict.rationale: Telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question for a SaaS content platform with SDKs, a CLI, and desktop clients, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any telemetry or analytics opt-out control. The general security and compliance marketing and the permission-governance claims are about protecting content, not about opting out of tracking.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
